canonicalStates.meaning: A number, text or fact is explicitly printed; never substitute computed crew math or another variant.
canonicalStates.phase0bFieldStatesTranslation: Field populated; no fieldStates status required (v0.5 lacks source-stated).

canonicalStates.meaning: Source explicitly states equipment or capability is absent.
canonicalStates.phase0bFieldStatesTranslation: Null only if schema permits it, plus /pointer explicitly-none (or not-applicable if justified).

canonicalStates.meaning: Reviewed page and relevant adjacent rules; no published value found.
canonicalStates.phase0bFieldStatesTranslation: Omit nested unresolved value and record /pointer not-stated; never null or zero.

canonicalStates.meaning: At least two incompatible printed readings; preserve both with exact source locators.
canonicalStates.phase0bFieldStatesTranslation: Omit adjudicated value, record /pointer unclear-source. Store alternatives in evidence, not production field.
Omit value, fieldStates /pointer not-yet-reviewed; cannot certify.

canonicalStates.meaning: Printed fact applies only to a mode, crew circumstance, or variant.
canonicalStates.phase0bFieldStatesTranslation: Retain condition-specific rule/variant record, not unconditional base property.

crossCuttingAssertions: An attack line or battery group is not evidence for physical weapon mount count or arcs.
Publisher silence after complete page review is positive evidence of silence, not an explicit equipment absence.
Explicit "no hyperdrive" and a statblock without Hyperdrive field are different states.
Printed source conflicts cannot be resolved by derived rules math or arbitrary preferred line.
Alternate configurations on a single statblock remain one source identity unless separately statblocked.
Mechanical certification requires full source-field/provenance reconciliation and mount/arc policy acceptance, not mere source review.
Source-silent physical topology can be represented with explicit evidence state but its acceptance for strict certification requires separate approved policy; this pilot authorizes none.
Phase0b schema is v0.5 draft, not frozen, and the historical Phase0B fixture/null gate remains red.

pressureFixtures.observation: Two physically stated low-yield light blaster cannons and two required gunners; one detailed gunner attack profile is printed.
Plural laser cannons; no number or firing arcs specified.
Advanced heavy laser configuration can explode on natural attack roll 1; alternate medium-laser configuration is a loadout of the same CL 12 statblock.
-20 vs smaller than Colossal in footnote; -17 vs smaller than Capital in weapon detail.
Separate tractor attack row has same category/modifier mismatch as turbolasers.
Autofire attack option is printed, detailed autofire attack bonus is not.
No printed shield rating, though DR is printed.
Stock Z-95 explicitly lacks hyperdrive in source prose.

pressureFixtures.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
pressureFixtures.observation: No statted weapon attack groups while narrative refers to modest defenses; cannot assert installed armament is absent.
Starfighter and walker movement modes on one printed ship.
Pseudograv field counters hyperdrive, not an energy damage weapon.
Main ion attack line +7; detailed ion weapon row +5.
Durability section prints DR 15; DR 20, so second DR cannot silently be relabeled SR.
Gargantuan starfighter targeting behavior applies only for specific combat interactions; printed ship remains Colossal.
No Hyperdrive printed. Do not assert explicitly unavailable.
38 narrated lasers; 8 laser battery attack groups; relationship between physical barrels and batteries not established.
